comment: The calendar's pure parts (D152, #616): references is a busy entry's reference number, eight characters of base32 (ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789, each byte mod 32) of the SHA-256 of its source, key and occurrence key, joined by NUL (Go's crosstable.CalendarReference, TypeScript's calendarReference, Rust's orm::calendar::calendar_reference); feeds is the iCalendar text of entries at a detail, full or busy, stamped at now (epoch milliseconds) under a calendar's name, its lines CRLF-ended and folded at 75 octets on a character's boundary (CalendarICS, calendarIcs, calendar_ics). An entry is the wire form a calendar read answers. runtime/schema/go/crosstable writes the wants with go test -run TestCalendarParityVectors -update.
